papers.title: StyleStream 2.0: Fast and Controllable Streaming Voice Style Conversion
papers.summary: StyleStream 2.0 improves streaming voice conversion with lower latency via a few-step MeanFlow model and enables text-based voice design and editing through a unified flow matching model.

papers.title: FrontierCS 2: A Benchmark for Computer Science R&D
papers.summary: FrontierCS 2 evaluates LLM agents on open-ended computer science R&D tasks using hidden evaluation suites and reveals that even the best agents pass only about half of tasks.

papers.title: Language Models Learn to Improve Language Models
papers.summary: LM2LM uses a frozen research world model to provide scalable reinforcement learning rewards for generating language model improvements, maintaining reliability through periodic real execution and outperforming larger baselines at lower cost.

papers.title: VerifierBench: Benchmarking the Generation of Executable Verifiers for LLM Agents
papers.summary: Agents generate executable verifiers to validate outputs, but these verifiers often wrongly reject valid solutions due to hidden assumptions, prompting recommendations to test acceptance of diverse correct answers.

papers.title: Looped Uniform Diffusion Language Models
papers.summary: Looping early Transformer layers improves training and inference efficiency of uniform diffusion language models without altering their objective or sampler.
